name: ogsm-online
description: Work with your OGSM.online plans, actions and comments from Claude, in the environment you choose.
long_description: Connects Claude to the OGSM.online API v3 with your personal API tokens. Configure one or more OGSM.online environments (host + personal API token). In every conversation Claude first asks which environment to work in; no tool works until you have chosen one. Read only tokens can only read; read and write tokens can also create and update actions, comments, objectives, goals, strategies and indicators.

env_1_host.title: Environment 1: host
env_1_host.description: OGSM.online environment, e.g. klant.ogsm.online or a dedicated server such as example.ogsm.online.

env_1_token.title: Environment 1: personal API token
env_1_token.description: Personal API token for this host (My settings → Personal API tokens). Read only tokens can only read.

env_2_token.title: Environment 2: personal API token
env_2_token.description: Personal API token for the host above.

env_3_token.title: Environment 3: personal API token
env_3_token.description: Personal API token for the host above.

env_4_token.description: Personal API token for the host above.

env_5_token.description: Personal API token for the host above.

tools.name: list_environments
tools.description: List the OGSM.online environments configured in the extension settings (host names only). Call this first, then ask the user which one to work in, even if there is only one.

tools.name: select_environment
tools.description: Select the OGSM.online environment the user explicitly chose for this conversation. Only call this with the host the user named in answer to your question; never pick one yourself, even if only one is configured. Returns an environment_session to pass to every other tool. Call again (after asking) to switch.

tools.name: list_canvases
tools.description: List the OGSM canvases the user can see, with their team id and status.

tools.name: list_teams
tools.description: List the teams the user belongs to.

tools.name: list_users
tools.description: List the users in the user's teams (id, name, email address), e.g. to find an assignee id.

tools.name: list_statuses
tools.description: List the statuses an action can have, in board column order.

tools.name: list_actions
tools.description: List the actions on a canvas.

tools.name: create_action
tools.description: Create an action on a canvas, optionally under a strategy (or under another action). Needs a read and write token.

tools.name: update_action
tools.description: Update an action. Only the fields passed are changed. Needs a read and write token.

tools.name: list_comments
tools.description: List the comments on an action.

tools.name: create_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to an action. Needs a read and write token.

tools.name: update_comment
tools.description: Change the content of a comment on an action. Needs a read and write token.

tools.name: delete_comment
tools.description: Delete one of the user's own comments on an action. Needs a read and write token.

tools.name: list_objectives
tools.description: List the objectives visible to the user, optionally only those on one canvas.

tools.name: create_objective
tools.description: Create an objective on a canvas. An objective stands on the OGSM itself and takes no parent. Needs a read and write token.

tools.name: update_objective
tools.description: Update an objective. Only the fields passed are changed. Needs a read and write token.

tools.name: list_goals
tools.description: List the goals visible to the user, optionally only those on one canvas.

tools.name: create_goal
tools.description: Create a goal on a canvas. Pass parent_id (a goal on the same canvas) to make it a sub goal. Needs a read and write token.

tools.name: update_goal
tools.description: Update a goal. Only the fields passed are changed. Needs a read and write token.

tools.name: list_strategies
tools.description: List the strategies visible to the user, optionally only those on one canvas.

tools.name: create_strategy
tools.description: Create a strategy on a canvas. A strategy stands on the OGSM itself and takes no parent. Needs a read and write token.

tools.name: update_strategy
tools.description: Update a strategy. Only the fields passed are changed. Needs a read and write token.

tools.name: list_indicators
tools.description: List the indicators visible to the user, optionally only those on one canvas.

tools.name: create_indicator
tools.description: Create an indicator on a canvas. parent_id is required: a strategy on the same canvas, or an indicator there for a sub indicator. Needs a read and write token.

tools.name: update_indicator
tools.description: Update an indicator. Only the fields passed are changed. Needs a read and write token.

tools.name: list_goal_reports
tools.description: List the measurements (reports) of goals, optionally of one goal.

tools.name: list_indicator_reports
tools.description: List the measurements (reports) of indicators, optionally of one indicator.
